;Disasters and accidents

;Health and environment
*[[Dog meat]]
**[[South Korea]] shuts down the country's largest dog meat [[slaughterhouse]]. The move is lauded by [[animal rights]] activists. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/11/22/asia/south-korea-dog-slaughterhouse-intl/ (CNN)]

;International relations
*[[Foreign relations of Denmark]]
**Denmark suspends future weapons export licenses to [[Saudi Arabia]] in response to the [[killing of Jamal Khashoggi]] and the [[Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-saudi-khashoggi-denmark/denmark-suspends-weapon-export-approvals-to-saudi-over-khashoggi-yemen-idUSKCN1NR0G6 (Reuters)]
*[[Brexit negotiations]]
**[[President of the European Council]] [[Donald Tusk]] says there is agreement "in principle" on a political deal that can be endorsed at an [[List of European Council meetings|EU summit]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/brexit/2018/1122/1012555-brexit/ (RTÉ)] 
**[[Spain]] threatens to vote against if there is no agreement on [[Gibraltar]] by which it demands new guarantees. [https://www.dailymail.co.uk/news/article-6418263/Spain-vows-vote-against-Brexit-deal-without-new-concessions-Gibraltar.html (''The Daily Mail'')]
*The [[United States]] urges their allies not to use [[Huawei]] network equipment, reportedly out of national security concerns. [https://thehill.com/policy/technology/418000-us-urging-allies-to-drop-chinas-huawei-report (''The Hill'')]

;Law and crime
*[[2017 Jewish Community Center bomb threats]]
**An Israeli-American man, Michael Kadar, is sentenced to 10 years in prison in Israel for making 2,000 hoax bomb threats that forced evacuations of Jewish community centers in the United States. The threats, made by phone and email in 2016 and 2017, raised concern that antisemitism was on the rise in the United States. [https://www.reuters.com/article/israel-crime-threats/us-israeli-man-sentenced-in-israel-over-global-bomb-threats-idUSL8N1XX2MS  (Reuters)]
*Chinese state media report that five people are killed and 18 others are injured after a car plowed into children outside a primary school in [[Huludao]], [[Liaoning]], [[China]]. [https://www.thestar.com/news/world/2018/11/22/children-hurt-by-vehicle-outside-of-school-chinese-state-media-reports.html (''Toronto Star'')]
*[[Me_Too_movement#South_Korea|Me Too movement in South Korea]]
**[[Jaerock Lee|Lee Jae-rock]], a [[South Korea]]n pastor and leader of [[Manmin Central Church]], is sentenced to 15 years in prison over 42 counts of sexual harassment and sexual assault against eight of his followers. According to the [[Seoul]] Central District Court, the victims could not resist his advances "due to their absolute faith in the infallibility of the accused." [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/11/22/asia/lee-jae-rock-pastor-indicted-intl/index.html (CNN)]

;Science and technology
*[[Global warming]]
**The [[World Meteorological Organization]] reports that average [[Carbon dioxide in Earth's atmosphere|global carbon dioxide concentrations]] rose to 405.5 [[Parts-per notation|parts per million]] in 2017. They say this level was not seen since at least 3 million years ago. [https://apnews.com/a2f10b10adcb47599158c7d912e7a308 (Associated Press)]

*[[World Chess Championship 2018]]
**After ten consecutive draws, a record for the 132-year-old championship, [[Magnus Carlsen]] and [[Fabiano Caruana]] are tied 5 points each in the best-of-12-games match. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/live/2018/nov/22/magnus-carlsen-v-fabiano-caruana-world-chess-championship-game-10-live (''The Guardian'')]
